name: clouddrive
description: CloudDrive RC14.12: bounded OneDrive health checks, Graph Delta, diagnostics and retry scheduling

scripts.build: npm run check:migrations && npm run test:all
scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:integration

DB.description: Stores users, permissions, uploads, shares, trash and audit metadata in D1.

PRIVATE_BUCKET.description: Private R2 bucket. Do NOT enable r2.dev or a public custom domain for this bucket.

PUBLIC_BUCKET.description: R2 bucket for deliberately public file copies. The Worker can serve them before a CDN domain is configured.

BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.description: Set a unique random secret (32+ characters, preferably 64 hexadecimal characters). Required only for the first super-admin account. Do NOT reuse the example placeholder or commit the token.

SHARE_LINK_KEY.description: Optional stable runtime Secret of exactly 64 hex chars (32 bytes). Enables AES-GCM encrypted recovery of NEW or rotated share URLs. Never rotate or lose the secret without a key migration plan.

MS_CLIENT_ID.description: Microsoft Entra App registrations > Overview > Application (client) ID (GUID). This is a runtime binding for the same deployed CloudDrive Worker.

MS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Runtime Secret: Microsoft Entra > Certificates & secrets > Client secret VALUE (not Secret ID).

MS_TOKEN_KEY.description: Runtime Secret generated by you, NOT by Microsoft. Use 32 cryptographically random bytes encoded as 64 hex chars (preferred) or Base64. Preserve this value; changing it breaks previously encrypted OneDrive OAuth tokens.

MS_TENANT.description: Optional Microsoft OAuth tenant (common for combined personal/organizational, consumers for personal only).

MS_REDIRECT_URI.description: Optional exact HTTPS Web callback URI. Use a canonical host: https://YOUR_HOST/api/v1/admin/onedrive/oauth/callback. Launch OAuth from this same origin and register the identical address in Microsoft Entra.

CDN_ZONE_ID.description: Optional Cloudflare zone ID for CDN cache purge after public R2 publication revocation.

CDN_PURGE_TOKEN.description: Optional runtime Secret with zone cache purge permission for PUBLIC_BASE_URL zone; never commit it.
